market_read.tone: Relief rally: futures up 2-3.5% after a correction week, chips and neoclouds +5-10% premarket, VIX back near 30, yields and oil lower; Thanksgiving week, thin after Tuesday.
market_read.day_type: event-driven (large gap up; early fade then chop is my slight lean, an all-day trend-up relief rally is the main alternative)
market_read.comment: Bias is open-to-close from the gap open, not vs. Friday's close (everything is up vs. Friday). SPY prior close 690.91; a +2.3% gap opens near 707, under Friday's 10:00 high 718.29. The lean comes from this month's gap-up fades and is weak (51/52): a fresh washout often gives a trend-up Monday. If SPY is above its opening 30-min high at 10:30, drop the down bias.
